list.intro: Every lot with its chromium VI result against the limit, its supplier documents and its release. A lot in quarantine is not used until a quality person releases it.
list.exportNothing: Nothing to export in this view
list.failedTitle: The lots could not be read

empty.title: No lot yet
empty.body: Receipts of leather and PPE components put their lots here. A lot that needs chromium VI evidence waits in quarantine until its result is recorded.

noAccess.title: Tests & substances is not open to your role
noAccess.body: It needs the permission to see lots' quality records (quality.lots.view): the quality inspector, the buyer and the warehouse have it. Ask your factory's owner to add it to your role.

tile.onHoldHint: In quarantine or blocked: not usable
tile.waitingHint: In quarantine, no result yet (counted among the lots on hold)
tile.failedHint: At or above the limit, not rejected yet

hint.LOT_REPORT: A laboratory tested a sample of this lot.
hint.SUPPLIER_REPORT: The supplier's report covers the article and a period that holds the day this lot was received.

title.SUPPLIER_REPORT_ACCEPTED: Chromium VI evidence: a supplier's report that covers the article and the period counts, as does a lab report on the lot.
title.LOT_REPORT_REQUIRED: Chromium VI evidence: only a lab report on the lot itself counts.

rule.limit: Limit {limit} mg/kg (REACH Annex XVII entry 47); a brand may set a lower one on the material.

source.TENANT: The rule of every company of the factory.
source.DEFAULT: The default rule: nobody has changed it.

rule.failed: The chromium VI evidence rule could not be read.

option.LOT_REPORT_REQUIRED: A lab report for every lot

optionHint.SUPPLIER_REPORT_ACCEPTED: The supplier's report that covers the article and the period counts, as does a lab report on the lot. This is the default.
optionHint.LOT_REPORT_REQUIRED: Only a lab report on the lot itself counts. Lots that rest on a supplier report go back to quarantine checks.

rule.limitNote: The legal limit of {limit} mg/kg is not a setting: it is the law.
rule.loosenTitle: This accepts more evidence than today
rule.loosenBody: Say why. Saving then asks for a fresh code from your authenticator app.
rule.reasonHint: Kept with the change, for the audit.

problem.cancelled: Not saved: the code was not given.
problem.conflict: Someone changed the rule in the meantime. It has been read again: check it and save again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not change this rule.
problem.invalid: The change was refused as it is: give the reason.
problem.failed: The rule could not be saved. Try again.

stepUp.loosen: Accepting more chromium VI evidence needs a fresh code.

pick.title: Record a test result
pick.sub: Choose the lot the report is for: the result is recorded on its page, against its limit.
pick.none: No lot is waiting for chromium VI evidence
pick.noneBody: Another lot's result (a later finding on a released lot) is recorded from that lot's page.

held.test: Recording a result needs the quality role (quality.lots.test).
held.documents: Attaching a supplier's document needs quality.lots.documents.
held.release: Releasing a lot needs the quality role (quality.lots.release).
held.reject: Rejecting or blocking a lot needs quality.lots.reject.
held.rule: Only the owner changes this rule (quality.settings.manage).
held.noTest: This material needs no chromium VI test.
held.rejected: The lot is rejected: that is final.
held.failFinal: The lot failed its chromium VI test: a fail is final (the law), reject the lot.
held.notQuarantine: Only a lot in quarantine is released.
held.notBlocked: Only a blocked lot is released again.
held.receiver: You received this lot: another quality person releases it.
held.checksOpen_one: {count} check is still open: see the checklist.
held.checksOpen_other: {count} checks are still open: see the checklist.
held.rejectState: Only a lot in quarantine or blocked is rejected.
held.blockState: Only a released lot is blocked.
held.noHold: There is no hold of the receiver to clear.
held.holdOwn: You placed this hold when receiving: another quality person clears it.
held.listMax: At most {max} lots are read at a time: search by code or choose a view.

record.title: Lot {code}
record.noPanels: The thread, files and history need permission to read threads (threads.read).
record.youReceived: You received this lot: you may record its results and documents, and another quality person releases it.

results.title: Chromium VI results
results.sub: Newest first; the verdict is computed against the limit of {limit} mg/kg, never typed.
results.notRequired: This material needs no chromium VI test.
results.emptyBody: The lot stays in quarantine until a result on evidence the rule accepts passes.
results.fileUnknown: The report file is not readable here
results.failFinal: A fail is final: no override (the law). A later fail on a released lot blocks it and lists the work orders it went to.

result.title: Chromium VI result for lot {code}
result.belowDetection: Not detected: below the detection limit
result.lodHint: The lab's detection limit in mg/kg: it must be at most the lot's limit.
result.supplierRefused: The rule in force asks for a lab report on every lot: a supplier's report does not count.
result.fileHint: A PDF or a scan (JPEG, PNG); kept ten years (REACH art. 36).
result.thenRelease: Release the lot when this passes
result.thenReleaseHint: Next you see the release checklist and type the lot's code: nothing is released without it.

verdict.none: Type the value: the verdict against the limit of {limit} mg/kg shows here.
verdict.pass: {value} mg/kg is below the limit of {limit} mg/kg – Pass
verdict.notDetected: Not detected: below the detection limit of {lod} mg/kg, so below the limit of {limit} mg/kg – Pass
verdict.fail: {value} mg/kg is at or above the limit of {limit} mg/kg – Fail
verdict.failBody: This lot cannot be used (REACH Annex XVII entry 47). A fail is final: reject the lot.
verdict.lodAbove: Below a detection limit of {lod} mg/kg does not show the lot is below its limit of {limit} mg/kg: the lab needs EN ISO 17075-2.
verdict.lodInvalid: Type the detection limit in mg/kg, above 0, at most 3 decimals.
verdict.valueInvalid: Type the value in mg/kg, from 0, at most 3 decimals.

problem.method: Choose the method of EN ISO 17075.
problem.value: Type the measured value, or tick "not detected".
problem.lab: Name the laboratory, as on its report.
problem.testedOn: Give the day of the test.
problem.testedOnFuture: The test day cannot be after today.
problem.ruleLotReport: The rule in force asks for a lab report on every lot.
problem.article: Name the article the supplier's report covers.
problem.periodFrom: Give the first day the report covers.
problem.periodTo: Give the last day the report covers.
problem.periodOrder: The period ends before it starts.
problem.upload: The file could not be sent to the store. Try again.
problem.refused: The result was refused as it is:
problem.conflict: The lot changed in the meantime. It has been read again: check it and save again.

documents.title: Supplier's documents
documents.sub: Certificates, declarations and test reports that came with the lot.
documents.emptyBody: An LWG certificate or a fabric test report can be attached here.
documents.emptyPpe: A certified PPE component is released only with the supplier's certificate or declaration for the lot.
documents.needsPpe: A certified PPE component: the supplier's PPE certificate or declaration for the lot, valid today.
documents.needsNone: No document is required before release for this material.
documents.needsLater: Material profiles with their required documents come with a later step.

document.title: Supplier document for lot {code}
document.sub: The file is kept with the lot.
document.subPpe: A PPE component needs the supplier's PPE certificate or declaration.
document.validToHint: Leave empty when the document has no end date.

problem.expired: It has already expired: attach a valid one.
problem.refused: The document was refused as it is. Check the kind, the date and the note.

hint.PPE_CERTIFICATE: The PPE component's certificate or the supplier's declaration for this lot.
hint.CR_VI_STATEMENT: The supplier's statement on chromium VI (not a test result).
hint.LWG_CERTIFICATE: The tannery's Leather Working Group certificate.
hint.FABRIC_TEST: A test report of the fabric's properties.
hint.OTHER: Say in the note what it is.

release.title: Release checklist
release.ready: Every check passes: the lot may be released by a quality person who did not receive it.

final.RELEASED: The lot is released: it may be issued to work orders. A later finding blocks it.
final.REJECTED: The lot is rejected: it goes back to the supplier or is scrapped. Nothing more is decided here.

release.who: Always a person: a quality person who did not receive the lot types its code to release it.

decide.typeCode: Type the lot code to confirm:

reject.title: Reject lot {code}
reject.final: Rejected is final: the lot goes back to the supplier or is scrapped.
reject.next: Next: a return to the supplier from Purchasing.

block.title: Block lot {code}
block.what: Blocking holds the lot: it cannot be issued until it is released again or rejected.
block.next: The work orders it already went to are listed after the block.

clearHold.title: Clear the receiver's hold on lot {code}
clearHold.what: The receiver held this lot with these words:

problem.checks: Not yet: these checks are still open.
problem.codeRefused: The typed code is not the lot code.
problem.refused: It was refused as it is:
problem.conflict: The lot changed in the meantime. It has been read again: check it and decide again.

problem.forbidden: Your role does not allow this on this lot.
problem.notFound: The lot is not there any more.
problem.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute.
problem.unavailable: The factory service did not answer. Try again.

answer.laterFail: Lot {code} failed on new evidence and is blocked
answer.registerOpened: PPE register entry {reference} opened for the garments made from it
answer.registerNone: No PPE register entry was opened:
answer.blocked_one: Blocked. It had gone to {count} work order:
answer.blocked_other: Blocked. It had gone to {count} work orders:

done.resultPass: Result saved: lot {code} passes its chromium VI test.
done.resultFail: Result saved: lot {code} failed its chromium VI test. Reject it.
done.resultLaterFail: Result saved: lot {code} failed on new evidence and is blocked.
done.release: Lot {code} released: it is usable stock.
done.clearHold: The receiver's hold on lot {code} is cleared.
done.ruleLoosened: Saved: a supplier's report covering the article and the period counts again.
done.ruleTightened: Saved: only a lab report on each lot counts from now on.
done.copyFailed: This browser did not allow copying.
done.downloadFailed: The file could not be downloaded. Try again.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.release: Release the lot (or release it again)
